mainEntity.name: What should I expect in my first structured group workout at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For your first structured group workout at Cave Training, you can expect a welcoming environment where coaches guide you through every movement. The session will typically start with a warm-up, followed by movement instruction and practice, the main workout, and a cool-down. It's helpful to arrive a few minutes early to introduce yourself to the coach and discuss any prior injuries or limitations you might have, allowing them to offer modifications.
